description: UERANSIM 3.3.0 UE registration + IPv4 PDU session against Open5GS 2.8.0 (AMF/SMF) and eUPF v0.7.2, captured on the Docker bridge. NAS ciphering NEA0, integrity NIA2, SUCI Profile A. See NOTES.md and INVENTORY.md.

conventions.direction: sender->receiver at the interface (gNB, AMF, SMF, UPF); NAS direction is 'UL' (UE->network) or 'DL'.
conventions.hex: lowercase, no separators; NGAP 'hex' is the whole NGAP-PDU (one SCTP DATA chunk, PPID 60); PFCP and GTP-U 'hex' is the UDP payload.
conventions.nas: Every NAS message gets its own entry after the NGAP message that carries it ('carried_in'). Protected messages give 'outer_hex' (whole security-protected message) and 'plaintext_hex' (the inner plain 5GMM message). 5GSM messages and the Registration request inside the NAS message container are separate entries with 'carried_in' pointing at their 5GMM container.
conventions.ies: NGAP: top-level ProtocolIE ids in wire order. NAS: top-level IE labels as Wireshark 4.6 names them, with the IEI for optional IEs. PFCP: every IE with its type, nested for grouped IEs.

ies.name: Authentication Parameter AUTN (UMTS and EPS authentication challenge) - 5G authentication challenge

messages.security_header: integrity protected with new 5G NAS security context

ies.name: UE security capability - Replayed UE security capabilities

messages.security_header: integrity protected and ciphered with new 5G NAS security context

ies.name: PDU session identity 2 - PDU session ID
Network Name - Full name for network
Time Zone and Time - Universal Time and Local Time Zone
PDU session identity 2 - PDU session ID
PDU session type - Selected PDU session type

secrets.note: Values marked 'captured' are on the wire in this capture. 'configured' values come from the setup files. 'derived' values were computed by setup/extract.py (an independent Python implementation of TS 35.206 Milenage and TS 33.501 Annex A) and confirmed against captured bytes as listed under 'checks'. None of them came from the kernel's own code.

sqn.source: derived: AUTN[0:6] xor AK; equals the Open5GS subscriber's provisioned SQN (64)

hres_star.source: derived; HRES*/HXRES* travel only on SBI, not captured

k_amf.source: derived; confirmed by NAS MACs and K_gNB

k_nas_int.source: derived; verifies every NAS MAC in the capture

k_gnb.source: captured (InitialContextSetupRequest Security Key) and derived from K_AMF with UL NAS COUNT 0

suci.ue_ephemeral_private_key: not recoverable (UERANSIM generates it per SUCI and does not log it)
suci.source: captured; ECIES values derived with the home-network private key

not_recoverable: UE ephemeral X25519 private key for the SUCI
SBI (HTTP/2) messages between AMF, AUSF, UDM, SMF: not captured by design
RRC: UERANSIM's radio link is simulated over UDP 4997 and was not captured
